text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-48213 triggered for tenant 'Catalyst' (reserved pool rsv-42) - P99 latency > 900ms and 5xx rate increase > 8% over 5m. Auto-escalation: SEV2.

Drew: saw the alert, getting paged. rsv-42 is the GPU reserved pool for Catalyst.

Maria: ACK. I'm pulling up metrics (latency, tail qps, queue depth). Looks like burst queueing at the scheduler, IO waits on worker nodes.

Liam: ACK from me as well. Oncall runbook: check pool utilization, evictions, and kvcache fallback.

Drew: logs from scheduler node (tail):
```
2026-03-14T01:12:30Z scheduler WARN queue_latency=1350ms pool=rsv-42 backlog=128
2026-03-14T01:12:31Z executor ERROR allocate_failed: no free CUDA contexts
2026-03-14T01:12:31Z allocator INFO evicting kvcache entries for model gpt-small quantized
```

Ashley: hitting the reserved pool autoscaler dashboard now — CPU on manager nodes is fine, but GPU utilization 100% on 3/4 workers and last worker is spiking memory alloc failures.

Maria: rolling mitigation idea: enable fallback routing for Catalyst to route non-SLO-critical requests to hosted fallback model variant `catalyst-hosted-fallback` for ~10m. That reduces pressure on reserved pool.

Liam: +1. Also we can temporarily bump reserved pool burst capacity (if policy allows) and reduce max_batch_size to lower tail latency. I'll apply batch override.

Drew: applying batch override: `PATCH /api/v1/pools/rsv-42/config {"max_batch_size": 32}` -> submitted.

pagerduty: PD-48213 acknowledged by Maria (@Maria). Escalation timer paused.

Maria: routing change in progress: updating routing policy to add fallback route for tenant Catalyst: `route_policy: prefer=rsv-42, fallback=hosted-catalyst-slim, max_fallback_pct=40` — deploying now.

Ashley: noticed a KV cache eviction storm — could explain repeated compute. Will disable KV writeback temporarily to avoid churn.

Drew: command to disable writeback: `kubectl exec -n inference svc/cache-config -- patch -p '{"writeback_enabled": false}'` -> applied. Watching for reduced evictions.

CS-Bot: customer-impact update from SE/CS: Catalyst reports increased API timeouts affecting ingestion pipeline, estimated ~12% of requests seeing >2s. We should notify account team if mitigation >15m.

Liam: autoscaler allowed one burst node; I'm increasing reserved burst capacity to +2 nodes (manual override) to add capacity now. Doing `POST /internal/admin/pools/rsv-42/scale?add=2`

Maria: routing change applied, batch override applied, cache writeback disabled. Early metrics: queue depth dropping from 128 -> 40 in 60s. P95 improving, but P99 still high ~700-800ms.

Ashley: new worker nodes are booting; one failed to attach due to driver mismatch — restarting node agent on that instance. `systemctl restart rwinference-agent` fixed attach. Now we have +1 healthy worker.

Drew: good signal: 5xx rate dropped from 8.6% -> 3.1% after routing & scaling. Still watching P99.

Maria: propose we keep fallback routing and batch override for 15 minutes, monitor. If stable, we can gradually drain fallback (reduce max_fallback_pct).

CS-Bot: sent update to Catalyst AM: "We've implemented temporary fallback routing and scaled your reserved pool; we're monitoring and will follow up. ETA to full resolution TBD."

Liam: leaving a short runbook note for post-incident: look into driver mismatches on auto-provisioned burst nodes, investigate KV cache eviction policy under quantized models.

Drew: ack and adding to incident channel for postmortem. If anything regresses, page again.

Katie: I'm taking night handoff at 02:45 UTC. Handoff note: pool rsv-42 currently stable after mitigations; watch P99 and active fallback pct. PagerDuty on call: @Katie-night.

Maria: handing to @Katie-night, summarizing actions in thread. I'll keep alerting hooks open for 15m then demote to watch.

pagerduty: PD-48213: incident status -> mitigated (partial) by Maria. If conditions worsen, will auto-reopen.

Drew: thanks all. Quick checklist for postmortem: root cause (burst node driver mismatch + kvcache eviction storm), mitigation timeline, customer impact (Catalyst ~12% >2s, short windows of 5xx), and action items (improve node boot validation, adjust kvcache policy, test fallback routing SLOs).

Katie: acknowledged and taking over. I'll patch handoff into the oncall rotation note.

incident-bot: Note: this thread will be auto-archived in 7 days.
